page.notes: Printed "Repubi.&" in the XI entry is uncertain; read as "Republ." [?] in the source is possible. The "Achaeorum" word may carry an æ ligature in print, read here as "Achaeorum". Faint show-through at the lower left ("VIII", "3") and faint ghost text across the lower page were ignored.
